tei:div.tei:p: "F 1$0000250rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi rtsa tshig bzhugs so// 1$0000290dkon mchog gsum dngos rtsa gsum gcig dril ba// karma pa la gus pas skyabs su mchi// 'gro kun byang chub thob phyir de nyid bsgrub// stong pa'i rang sgra hūm̐ yig sngo dmar 'phros// sngon po rdor ra dmar po me rir gyur// de nang bh+rūm̐ gyi sgra las gzhal yas khang*// de nang rma bya pad+ma zla ba'i steng*/ hrīḥyig dmar po las gyur bdag mdun lha// zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs gnyis skyil krung bzhugs// rtsa zhal tshe dpag med dmar chags pa'i nyams// g.yas zhal spyan ras gzigs dkar zhi ba'i zhal// g.yon zhal ma hā kā la khros pa'i zhal// sku mdog dmar gsal pad 'byung gar dbang phyug /dang po'i phyag gnyis dpag bsam tshe bum brgyan// bar pas gri gug thod khrag phag mo yum// tha mas phreng dmar pad sdong thugs rje'i bdag /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i ngo bor bzhugs pa ste// dar dang rin chen du mas rnam par brgyan// thams cad gcig 'dus rgyal ba karma pa// ye nas dam ye dbyer med dran rdzogs gsal// sngags phreng zhal nas thon nas mdun bskyed kyi// zhal zhugs thugs brgyud rang gi thugs kar 'khor// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma rā ga ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra sa mā dzaḥbadz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ bhūm̐ nṛ dzaḥtshe bsod rgyas dbang du gyur cig

'dod gsol 'di rgyun du ma byas kyang rung*/ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe sogs shab+da/ rū pa sogs nas spar+she/ mā taṅgi āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gtor ma yod na rtsa sngags la/ ba lin+ta khā hi/ bcom ldan pad+ma tshe dpag med// rang byung rol pa'i rdo rje ste// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma bcas rol// rdo rje dbyangs can bzang por bstod// rang gi lte bar rdo rje zla ba yi/ kha chod can gyi bhan+dha bdud rtsis gang*// rdo rje'i khong seng dbu ma mtshan nyid ldan// oṃ badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+ya hūm̐ zhes pa yi// sgra yis rlung rngub lte ba'i bdud rtsir gyur// dbu ma nas brgyud lus gang 'chi med thob// mdun bskyed las 'phros de 'dra spyan drangs nas// spyi bor bzhugs la yid kyis gsol ba gdab// rtsa sngags la badz+ra kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dzñā na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de yi dpral mgrin thugs ka lte ba nas// 'od zer dang 'dres bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing*// rang gi gnas bzhir thim pas lus kun gang*// spyi bo'i lha de yab yum skad cig la phag mo dang 'khyud pa zhal sbyor gyur// sbyor mtshams byang sems rgyun babs rtsa gnas gang*// yum las yum 'phros bdag dang 'khyud byas pas// dga' ba bzhi yi ye shes nyams su myong*// skye med 'chi ba bral ba la// spros na spros med gzi brjid can// bsdus na bdag gzhan gnyis ma dmigs// gnyis spangs dbyer med lu gu rgyud// brtan cing mi 'gyur chos kyi dbyings// rang rig gser gyi rdo rje lus tshad kyi// lte bar hrīḥyig dmar po las// rang ming rgya skyegs bris 'dra gsal// de nas dmigs med ngang du bzhag / ces rā ga a s+yas bsnyen pa tshar nyin sbyar ba'o// maṅga laṃ// //
